_doc: Per-head daily rates. engine/build.py multiplies them by props.count. Every rate cites docs/research. trust: web = external page, ai_report = NotebookLM summary (re-verify before Phase 4 planner).

hen.source: docs/research A1 [3]: Hy-Line barn layers eat 115-122 g/head/day (midpoint 118.5 g)
docs/research A1 [1,2]: 180-240 mL/head/day at 21 C (midpoint 210 mL), over 600 mL at 38 C
docs/research A1 [3]: Hy-Line Brown lays 354 eggs to 80 weeks; first egg at 18 weeks [14], so 354 / 434 laying days
docs/research A1 [2,31]: 110-130 g wet manure/bird/day (midpoint 120 g)

cow.source: docs/research A2 [2,4]: 75-100 L/day at 15-20 C (midpoint 87.5 L), 121+ L at 35 C
docs/research A2 [2,4,45]: 50-65 kg wet manure/cow/day (midpoint 57.5 kg)

goat.source: docs/research A2 [1,2]: dairy goats 1.5-2.5 kg DM/day (midpoint 2 kg)
docs/research A2 [1,2]: 4-10 L/day normal (midpoint 7 L), up to 15 L hot
docs/research A2 [1,2]: dairy goats 1.5-4.0 kg milk/day (midpoint 2.75 kg)
docs/research A2 [1,2,45]: 1.5-2.5 kg wet manure/day (midpoint 2 kg)

sheep.source: docs/research A2 [1,2,45]: 1.8-2.8 kg wet manure/day (midpoint 2.3 kg)
